styleRevision: User-requested clean white dashboard and small original cartoons
cover: Create a fresh GainFrame blog cover, landscape 4:3. Reference 1 is STYLE ONLY: take its clean white software dashboard, hairline cool-gray borders, tiny charming hand-drawn cartoon avatars, sensible typography, lots of white space. DO NOT reproduce its brand, customer names, revenue rows, browser bookmarks or interface. Reference 2 is the GainFrame mascot FACE IDENTITY: four disconnected scan-frame corners, black except red lower-right, two asymmetrical googly eyes and sweeping S nose on white. Our own spin: an original clean, flat 2D cartoon scene of three useful fitness browser tools leading to an iPhone photo timeline. White background #FFFFFF, almost-black #181A1E, cool-gray #E5E7EB outlines, one clear blue #3B82F6 used sparingly. Small red only in the GainFrame face logo. At left, a single neat rounded browser panel labeled 'Free fitness tools' with three generously spaced rows, each with a small ORIGINAL hand-drawn adult gym-goer avatar and a thin neutral icon. The row labels exactly 'Physique Rater', 'Body Visualizer', 'Photo Estimator'. At right, simple flat phone with abstract progress photo thumbnails and tiny timeline dots; title 'GainFrame'. A thin playful curved arrow from browser to phone has the small handwritten annotation 'keep tracking'. The mascot face, small and charming, peeks over the browser's upper corner with two small gloved cartoon hands. Head must preserve reference mark geometry and black-red face, no full muscular body. Original friendly avatar drawings, thin ink outlines, simple skin tones and blue/gray gym shirts. Pixel-crisp UI, open white space, calm and bright, editorial product illustration, no glossy dimensional effects. No charts, no numerical statistics, no invented customer data, no huge headline. NO cream, beige, sage, forest green, gold, salmon, paper grain, plants, scenery, shadows, 3D, gradients, serif lettering, gigantic heavy type, decorative stars, extra slogans or watermarks. Everything flat white and thoughtfully restrained.
funnel: Create a clean 3:2 landscape diagram for GainFrame. Reference 1 is visual STYLE ONLY: pure white software UI, hairline cool-gray borders, small original hand-drawn cartoon avatars and restrained bright-blue accents. Do not copy its brand, customer data, bookmarks, text or specific interface. Reference 2 is GainFrame mascot FACE IDENTITY: disconnected scan-frame corners, black except red lower-right, googly eyes and S-curve nose. Pure white background #FFFFFF, near-black #181A1E, fine cool-gray #E5E7EB strokes, sparse #3B82F6 blue. Strictly flat, no cream, paper textures, plants, shaded panels, gradients, shadows, 3D, serif type, green or gold. Clean Inter/Helvetica type, thin rounded software frames. Headline exactly 'How the free tools lead to the app'. Four equal sections LEFT TO RIGHT with thin hand-drawn arrows. 1: charming tiny ORIGINAL cartoon gym-goer in a white circle, beside a simple search bar 'rate my physique'; label 'Search a specific question'. 2: neat browser window with a thin-line photo placeholder and analysis lines, tiny small GainFrame mascot face at corner; label 'Get a useful free result', caption 'Photo score or visual reference'. 3: a restrained phone outline and a thin blue down arrow icon; label 'Open the app listing', caption 'A clear next step after the result'. 4: simple phone timeline of three flat line-art progress-photo thumbnails with the SAME tiny cartoon gym-goer shown repeatedly, label 'Track changes over time', caption 'Repeated check-ins in GainFrame'. Illustration avatars occupy at most 15% of image, lots of open white space. Four sections not a giant grid of chunky cards. Footer below a fine gray separator exactly 'This is the intended path. I can measure Store clicks; paid subscriptions are still unlinked.' All text must be legible dark charcoal with large margins; no extra words or fake numeric results. Distinctive lighthearted cartoon touches within a minimal, precisely aligned data-product layout.
